name: sleek-line-cursor

frames.best_why: The trail forms a bright pink loop, the clearest single curve of all six frames.

tagline: A thin coloured line trails behind the pointer, bending as it moves.
summary: A single hair-thin stroke is pulled along behind the mouse by a spring, so it swoops and loops rather than tracking exactly. Its colour drifts slowly through hues over a dark stage.
appearance: Almost nothing sits on the black stage except a thin bordered rectangle holding a line of pale text. Across it runs one hair-thin curved stroke in a dim pinkish red, following the moving pointer. The rest of the frame is empty black.
behaviour: The stroke is a chain of points pulled toward the cursor by a spring, so it lags, overshoots and curls into loops like a loose thread. Its hue cycles slowly, and it redraws every frame over the cleared canvas.
demo_content: A dark bordered panel with the text Move your mouse to see the cursor trail effect.
search_phrases: line that follows the mouse pointer
mouse trail effect on a website
custom cursor that leaves a streak
use_when: A portfolio or creative landing page that wants a subtle, distinctive pointer flourish over a dark hero.
avoid_when: Runs a full-screen fixed canvas with global listeners, is faint at 1px, and offers nothing on keyboard or touch.
customise: Tune the number of trail lines, spring friction, node count, dampening and tension as props; the hue range and stroke opacity are written into the source.
weight_why: A requestAnimationFrame loop updates about a thousand spring nodes every frame across the window.

a11y.note: Decorative pointer effect with no reduced-motion check, so the constant full-screen animation keeps running for motion-sensitive users.

issues: The 1px line is very faint against black.
Prevents default on pointer moves, which can block scrolling on touch devices.
polish_why: Subtle and smooth, but the line is so faint it barely registers as a custom cursor.
